header.running_head: The Bravery of Hadhrat Zubayr bin Awwaam (RA)

blocks.text: As the Muslims were leaving Uhud, Rasulullaah ﷺ told (the famous poet) Hadhrat Hassaan (RA) to says something in praise of Hadhrat Talha (RA). He obliged by saying the following couplets (which meant):

"On the day of the valley (the Battle of Uhud), Talha assisted Muhammad ﷺ
During a time of extreme hardships and difficulties
With his bare hands he shielded (Rasulullaah ﷺ) from the arrows
And placed his hand beneath the swords (to shield Rasulullaah ﷺ) because of which it was paralysed
After Muhammad ﷺ, he led all the others
He erected the mill of Islaam until it could function by itself"
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) then recited the following (which meant):

"Talha defended the Nabi of guidance as the cavalry chased him
When they eventually caught up, he defended all of Deen
He patiently bore the injuries when his comrades had left
At that time, people were either rightly guided or misguided
O Talha bin Ubaydillaah! Incumbent for you
is the gardens of Jannah and marriage to its beautiful wide-eyed damsels"
Hadhrat Umar (RA) then said the following couplet (in praise of Hadhrat Talha (RA)):

"He defended the Nabi of guidance with his drawn sword
at a time when everyone had fled and dispersed"

Rasulullaah ﷺ then commented, "What you have said is true, O Umar." [^1] The manner in which Hadhrat Talha (RA) fought during the Battle of Uhud has already been narrated (in the chapter "Rasulullaah ﷺ Endures Hardship and Difficulty when Giving Da'wah towards Allaah" under the subheading "The Hardship Rasulullaah ﷺ Bore During the Battle of Uhud").
The Bravery of Hadhrat Zubayr bin Awwaam
Hadhrat Zubayr (RA) Emerges with a Drawn Sword in Makkah before the Hijrah

Hadhrat Sa'eed bin Musayyib (RA) says that the first person to draw a sword for the pleasure of Allaah was Hadhrat Zubayr bin Awwaam (RA). He was in Makkah one day when he heard that Rasulullaah ﷺ was assassinated. He immediately left home with a drawn sword when he came face-to-face with Rasulullaah ﷺ. Rasulullaah ﷺ enquired, "What is the matter, Zubayr?" "I heard that you had been assassinated," he replied. "What were intending to do in that case?" Rasulullaah ﷺ asked. "By Allaah!" replied Hadhrat Zubayr (RA), "I had intended to tackle all the people of Makkah." Rasulullaah ﷺ then prayed for him.
